input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: No express "liquidated damages" or penalty clause exists, and the only service-credit reference (1.5) runs in our favour. However, Section 2.1 is a disguised Customer-payable liquidated amount: it fixes USD 2,000,000 per year (USD 6,000,000 total) payable on a take-or-pay basis "without reduction or termination rights", so we would owe the full remaining contract value for Services never consumed even after terminating for Vendor breach. That exceeds the walk-away threshold (liquidated amounts equal to remaining contract value) and conflicts with 7.1 (no unstated minimum-use charge), 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment) and 27.3 (termination "without penalty"). The redline removes the binding minimum and states that no take-or-pay, penalty, liquidated damages, or early-termination amount is payable by Customer, with a three-months'-Fees early-termination fee offered as fallback.

proposal.summary: Remove the Customer-payable take-or-pay/minimum-fee liability in 2.1 and confirm no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee is payable by Customer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have converted the take-or-pay commitment in 2.1 into a non-binding volume expectation, because as drafted it obliges us to pay up to USD 6,000,000 for Services we may never receive and strips our reduction and termination rights, which is a liquidated damages/penalty payable by Customer that our playbook does not accept. If Cobalt needs some downside protection, we can discuss a single early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer expects, but is not obligated, to purchase approximately USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years. Customer shall pay only for Services it actually orders under an Order Form, and no take-or-pay charge, shortfall payment, minimum fee, penalty, liquidated damages, or early-termination fee is payable by Customer. Customer's rights to reduce quantities and to terminate in accordance with this Agreement are unaffected.
